rows.words: THE AUTHOR’S AMENDMENT to (R365), row 1. N5’s clause “no folder name of the host in a bank” is withdrawn as written; the navigator wrote it wider than my rule. In its place: the closing and the mirror bank name the mirror’s folder by role, as (2)(iii) orders, and no bank the seat writes by hand names a folder of mine. The captures the tools write of a repository’s own path (the suite’s run files and banks, the push-outs, the command capture, the act root, the carry bank) stand as written, at this act and before it, and are outside the clause. N5 is read by these words.
